name: zclass_node_get_bbox
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeGetBBox copies a node's cached min/max bounds when the cached-bounds flag is present.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass bounds helper source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x448760 validates ECX as node, EDX as outBBox, null node and null class-data error paths through zError::ReportOldNoOp returning 5, the cached-bounds flag 0x100 gate returning 1 when absent, and a six-dword copy from node->cachedBounds at offset 0x74 to outBBox before returning 0.
The native zClass smoke verifies successful six-float bbox copy, absent cached-bounds flag return, and null node/class-data error returns.
